newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria to open its waters to more foreign vessels.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to open its waters to more foreign vessels.

text.p: Algeria, which opened its territorial waters for the first time this year for Japanese vessels to catch tuna, will extend the measure to more foreign tuna fishers, the official Algerian news APS said on Sunday.
Junior fisheries minister Bouguerra Soltani, who was quoted by APS as announcing the government decision, gave no details.
The government allowed Japanese vessels from last April to fish for tuna in Algerian waters in a $17 million deal.

The junior minister said the government and local fishing enterprises planned to invest 30 billion dinars ($540 million) in the next four years to upgrade Algeria's fishing fleet and improve maritime infrastructures.
The investment will generate more than 40,000 jobs in the fishing sector, APS said.
